data.title: Verdict: AcmeDB, No Chaser
data.subject: AcmeDB
data.take: the boring database that actually ships, and boring has never looked this good
data.summary: AcmeDB does one thing, durable key-value storage, and it does that one thing without needing an operator PhD. No consensus wizardry, no sharding astrology; just a WAL, a manifest, and docs that answer the question you actually asked. Refreshing as hell.

receipts.evidence: vendor benchmark on a laptop, not replicated
the docs list snapshots as 'coming soon'

data.bottom_line: Ship it behind a cache, damn it. Your crown jewels belong anywhere else.
caveats: We did not run our own benchmark. The latency number is theirs, not ours.
Checked against the docs on the date above. Roadmaps move.
